FFmpeg 8.1.2 / x264 — 32-bit H.264/AAC MP4 export helper for EP128Emu.
This GPL component runs as a SEPARATE executable (ep128emu-ffmpeg.exe).
FFmpeg source: FFmpeg 8.1.2 tar.xz
 SHA-256: 464beb5e7bf0c311e68b45ae2f04e9cc2af88851abb4082231742a74d97b524c
x264 source: https://github.com/mirror/x264.git
 pinned commit: c24e06c2e184345ceb33eb20a15d1024d9fd3497
Source/rebuild instructions: docs/EP128EMU_WIN32_FFMPEG_045_SOURCE_TRIAL.md
Build scripts: tools/w45_build_x264_win32.sh, tools/w45_build_minimal_ffmpeg_win32.sh
The complete corresponding source is separately distributed as
 ep128emu-0.45-win32-ffmpeg-sources.zip alongside the Windows installer.
The accompanying FFmpeg and x264 code are GPL-licensed (see LICENSE files).
The EP128Emu emulator itself does not link against FFmpeg or x264.
